title: The Sunday the Typewriters Grew Moss
description: On the printshop’s spring holiday, the typewriters spend a day in the garden. By noon, violets have come up between the keys.
alt: Moss, purple violets, and fern fronds grow through an old black typewriter on a garden table. A blue apron and loose petals lie beside it.
pairing: A printshop’s spring holiday × typewriters sprouting moss and violets
